fields.label: Floor
fields.description: Optional. Blank = location-only assignment (today's behavior). Set once this machine's physical floor has an IB Production Floor record with the right stages checked.

fields.label: Wastage Norm %
fields.description: Alert fires when entry wastage exceeds this threshold

fields.label: Running Cost per Hour (₹)
fields.description: Labour + power + overhead for one hour on this machine. Added to the cost of every roll it makes. Blank = IB Stock Settings default.

fields.label: Linked Asset
fields.description: Optional link to the ERPNext Asset record for this machine, for OEE/maintenance-downtime tracking. Not required — most real machines here have no corresponding Asset record yet.

fields.options: Physical limits used by machine assignment. Every field left blank = no constraint — the machine then behaves exactly like today (load-balanced only). Fill these in per machine once the shop-floor numbers are known. Only the fields relevant to this machine's type matter (a Packing station needs none).

fields.label: Max Input Width (mm)
fields.description: Widest jumbo / roll this machine accepts. Coating, Slitting, Rewinding.

fields.label: Max Output Width (mm)
fields.description: Widest finished roll this machine can produce. Cutting, Rewinding.

fields.label: Min Slit / Cut Width (mm)
fields.description: Narrowest strip a knife/blade can hold. Slitting, Cutting.

fields.label: Knife / Blade Positions
fields.description: Max simultaneous output rolls in one pass. Slitting, Cutting.

fields.label: Min Core Diameter (mm)
fields.description: Smallest core this machine's chuck/mandrel can hold. Slitting, Rewinding.

fields.label: Max Core Diameter (mm)
fields.description: Largest core this machine's chuck/mandrel can hold. Slitting, Rewinding.

fields.label: Line Speed (m/min)
fields.description: Drives time-based load (queued minutes). Blank = fall back to queued-WO count.

fields.label: Changeover (min)
fields.description: Rough minutes to re-set for a new width/knife layout. Used only to rank machines, not scheduled exactly.

fields.label: Current Setup Signature
fields.description: Auto: the last run's width/knife signature on this machine. A new run matching it incurs zero changeover in the ranking.
